cooldown.binNote: ddragon lists cooldown as 0 for all ranks (the ability itself has no cooldown), but the bin's PoisonTrail.ToggleCooldown = 1 defines a separate 1s cooldown on re-toggling the ability.

values.binNote: Per-tick values are the per-second BaseDamagePerSecond/APRatioPerSecond values (from PoisonTrail#DamagePerSecond) divided by TicksPerSecond=4; no bin row states the per-tick number directly.

values.quote: The target takes {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over 2 seconds
The target takes {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over 2 seconds
values.binNote: The wiki states the interval directly as 0.25 seconds; the bin instead stores the reciprocal rate PoisonTrail.TicksPerSecond=4 (4 ticks per second = 1/4 = 0.25s interval), so the two numbers are the same quantity expressed as a rate vs. a period.

mechanics.claim: Poison Trail is a toggle that continually damages enemies standing in its lingering cloud; the on-hit poison debuff deals magic damage every 0.25s over 2 seconds, and reapplication refreshes the duration.
mechanics.quote: The target takes {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over 2 seconds as well as upon being hit if not currently affected. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.

mechanics.claim: When the poison debuff is first applied (not refreshed), the target is dealt one extra instance of the debuff's damage at the same time, via a 0.1s delayed second application.
mechanics.quote: When ''Poison Trail's'' debuff is applied instead of refreshed, the target is dealt one additional instance of the debuff at the same time as the application. This is done by delaying the actual debuff by {{fd|0.1}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: A cloud rechecks for valid targets within it every 0.25 seconds, refreshing the debuff duration on targets it re-hits.
mechanics.quote: a cloud checks for valid targets who remain in or re-enter a cloud every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Toggling Poison Trail does not count as an ability activation, so it does not trigger on-cast effects.
mechanics.quote: Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: Poison Trail automatically toggles off if Singed cannot pay its mana-per-second cost.
mechanics.quote: ''Poison Trail'' is toggled off automatically if '''Singed''' becomes unable to pay its {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost.

mechanics.claim: Individual toxic clouds spawn based on Singed's movement, spawning less frequently and closer together when he has moved little.
mechanics.quote: If '''Singed''' has moved fewer than 90 units since spawning the last poison cloud, it will spawn 35 units in front of him. They also only spawn every 1 second in this case.
